label: FP
reason: The identified cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability is based on a misinterpretation of the data flow. The user input 'param' is sanitized via the Test.doSomething method which extracts only the first token from the split array (param.split(" ")[0]). This effectively limits the input to a single word, preventing arbitrary script injection. Furthermore, the only potential source value is derived from a user-controlled parameter, but it is immediately processed through a safe transformation in the inner class Test.doSomething(), where it is split and truncated to just the first element. There is no direct concatenation of untrusted input into HTML output. The sink locations reference cookie names and values, which are generated deterministically and never directly injected with user input.

evidence.note: The user input is processed through a safe split operation in the inner class Test.doSomething(), limiting exposure to only the first token.
